final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT City, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY City), city_average AS (SELECT AVG(employee_count) AS average_count FROM city_counts), kept AS (SELECT c.employee_count, c.employee_count - a.average_count AS difference FROM city_counts AS c JOIN city_average AS a ON a.average_count IS NOT NULL WHERE c.employee_count > a.average_count) SELECT AVG(employee_count) AS average_employee_count, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM kept
